attendance-day.name: Attendance Day
attendance-day.description: From the attendance export, list the program date by room, child label they allow, and present/absent or in/out as they coded it.

holiday-calendar-pack.name: Holiday Calendar Pack
holiday-calendar-pack.description: Copy the year’s closures, staff-only days, and tuition-charged holidays from their calendar file.

incident-routing.name: Incident Routing
incident-routing.description: From the incident log, list dated forms that still need a director signature, a parent-notice box, or a missing page.

licensing-packet-completeness.name: Licensing Packet Completeness
licensing-packet-completeness.description: Against their visit checklist, list named binder pages as present or missing.

missing-enrollment-forms.name: Missing Enrollment Forms
missing-enrollment-forms.description: From the enrollment PDF folder, list each named packet page as present, dated, signed, or missing.

pickup-list-check.name: Pickup List Check
pickup-list-check.description: Compare the live pickup list to the roster and to any sign-out adults they exported.

ratio-from-their-posted.name: Ratio From Their Posted
ratio-from-their-posted.description: Compare children present from attendance to staff on their schedule using only the posted ratio.

tuition-from-file.name: Tuition From File
tuition-from-file.description: Build a tuition or past-due list only from their rate sheet and ledger export.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.description: From their waitlist workbook, list date added, requested room or age band, desired start, and deposit status.
